purpose: Teach: 非課税/管区/掌握/発現/短調/寛大/トップクラス/発効

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、非課税口座制度を社員に周知しろ
lines.en: Make sure all staff are informed about our tax-free savings account system.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands precisely. No negotiation in the tempo. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業管区の見直しを進めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll move forward with reviewing our sales territories.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Steady, measured response. Professional acknowledgment without flourish. The measured calm of someone who has received clear direction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場の掌握を急げ
lines.en: We need to secure our market position faster.
lines.style: Sharper urgency now. Slight lean forward in the delivery. The word 'faster' carries weight. Impatience that's controlled but present. This is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の効果が発現するまで時間がかかります
lines.en: Understood. The new product's effects will take time to materialize.
lines.style: Careful, informative tone. Not defensive—explanatory. Even pacing, delivered with quiet professionalism. The pragmatism of someone delivering facts without excuses.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社のBGMを短調から長調に変えろ
lines.en: Change our company BGM from minor key to major key.
lines.style: Directive and oddly specific. Delivered with the same authority as the others—no hesitation, no question mark. The confidence of someone making an unusual decision as if it were routine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。顧客には寛大な対応を致します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ensure our customers receive generous treatment.
lines.style: Compliant, warm undertone. The acknowledgment of a shift in direction. Not contradicting—adapting. Professional but slightly softer than before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界トップクラスの品質を目指せ
lines.en: Our goal is industry-leading quality. Aim for that.
lines.style: Visionary but grounded. A statement of principle, not a complaint. Steady conviction. The tone of someone who believes in the standard and expects alignment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新法の発効日を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll confirm the effective date of the new regulations.
lines.style: Crisp closing acknowledgment. Professional, efficient. The final word—no elaboration. The punctuation mark on the conversation.
